findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: list_freeze_events · Private data: get_address_status, get_token_statistics, get_token_policy, get_coverage, list_freeze_events, get_biggest, watch_address · Public sink: watch_address.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: list_freeze_events · Private data: get_address_status, get_token_statistics, get_token_policy, get_coverage, list_freeze_events, get_biggest, watch_address · Public sink: watch_address

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
